keyEvents.text: First Half begins.

Goal! San Jose Earthquakes 1, Houston Dynamo FC 0. Ronaldo Vieira (San Jose Earthquakes) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Timo Werner with a cross following a corner.
Agustin Resch (Houston Dynamo FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! San Jose Earthquakes 2, Houston Dynamo FC 0. Eduard Löwen (San Jose Earthquakes) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the top left corner.
Artur (Houston Dynamo FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, San Jose Earthquakes 2, Houston Dynamo FC 0.
Substitution, Houston Dynamo FC. Duncan McGuire replaces Lyle Foster.
Second Half begins San Jose Earthquakes 2, Houston Dynamo FC 0.
Substitution, Houston Dynamo FC. Lawrence Ennali replaces Ibrahim Aliyu.
Substitution, Houston Dynamo FC. Agustín Bouzat replaces Héctor Herrera.
Timo Werner (San Jose Earthquakes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Reid Roberts (San Jose Earthquakes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Jamar Ricketts replaces Timo Werner.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Ian Harkes replaces Vítor Costa.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Dave Romney replaces Ronaldo Vieira.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Ousseni Bouda replaces Preston Judd.
Substitution, Houston Dynamo FC. Nick Markanich replaces Duane Holmes.

Goal! San Jose Earthquakes 2, Houston Dynamo FC 1. Duncan McGuire (Houston Dynamo FC) header from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Mateusz Bogusz with a cross following a corner.
Agustin Resch (Houston Dynamo FC) is shown the red card.
Lucas Halter (Houston Dynamo FC) is shown the yellow card.
Jamar Ricketts (San Jose Earthquakes) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Nick Fernandez replaces Eduard Löwen.
Second Half ends, San Jose Earthquakes 2, Houston Dynamo FC 1.
